context: Interactive US county-level election swing choropleth with a linked histogram and year slider — a data visualization.
first_impression: The map panel is completely blank — county fills are invisible against the dark background, leaving only the title, legend labels, and controls visible.
what_works: Design intent is evident in the code: dark theme palette (#111827), Inter typeface, indigo accent on the slider and brush, and a clean two-panel layout with generous header hierarchy.
what_doesnt: The map fails the hard gate — county geometry renders with no visible fills (either the CDN fetch for the US atlas timed out at screenshot time, or fill colors collapse into the dark background), making the entire data encoding invisible. The histogram panel is also blank, so neither linked view delivers any information.
